title: rosa × odorata var. gigantea
intro: Rosa × odorata var. gigantea, commonly known as the Damask rose or giant fragrant rose, is a large and fragrant rose species widely cultivated for its ornamental and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rosa × odorata var. gigantea include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate anxiety, and improve sleep quality due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which can be used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as geraniol and linalool, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
